verdict.rationale: USPTO does expose machine APIs: a developer portal exists at developer.uspto.gov, api.uspto.gov returns an API-key auth challenge, and Patent Center mentions direct API calls. However, nothing in the pack documents an interactive API reference or runnable try-it examples. The developer portal is only observed as a JS app shell, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, so the applicable capability is unevidenced.
